import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.widgets import SpanSelector

# Issue repro: xlim must stay at (10,20)+margins
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot([10, 20], [10, 20])
print('xlim before:', ax.get_xlim())

fig.canvas.draw()

# Vertical direction too

do_event(ss, 'release', xdata=15, ydata=15, button=1)
print('extents after selection:', ss.extents)
assert ss.extents == (12, 15)
print('OK: bounds preserved, selection works')
